item: Playtime Percentage tables labelled '(Unofficial)' in the official Game Book
detail: Four of the thirteen Week 10 Game Books print the Playtime Percentage table with an '(Unofficial)' label (g05 HOU@CLE, g09 BUF@NYJ, g11 SEA@LV, g13 LAR@AZ). The table is still the one published inside the official NFL Game Book PDF linked from the official Game Centre; the label is recorded verbatim on each row and the desk does not treat these as a different source class. The desk does not claim the label was removed or that these counts are certified official statistics.
route: none - the label is part of the official artefact and is published as printed

item: Depth-vs-snap cross-reference returns zero joinable rows
detail: The committed official club depth-chart transcription (nfl-skill-cfdd/data/depth-slots-2026-11-14.csv) covers CHI, DEN, PHI and TB only. None of the four played in Week 10, so there is no game in which to compare a printed depth order against actual snap counts. The cross-reference is therefore a published zero-row gap, not a satisfied join.
why_blank: no overlap between the four depth-chart clubs and the 26 clubs that played
route: capture official depth charts for the 26 clubs that played in Week 10

item: LAC @ BAL (W10-14) has no Playtime Percentage table
detail: The fourteenth Week 10 fixture (LAC @ BAL, Monday 2026-11-16) had not produced a Game Book at capture time, so no Playtime Percentage table exists for it. The desk publishes the 13 played fixtures only; the 14th is carried as a known gap.
why_blank: the official Game Book for W10-14 was not available at capture
route: re-capture the W10-14 Game Book after the game is final
